messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started for service: inference-api, release: v3.7.1, slice=region-slice-1 (US primary). Details: https://releases.internal/redwood/v3.7.1 :rocket:

ryan: starting the US slice now. can we confirm the preflight hooks passed?

arjun: preflight ok. smoke checks green on canary (1%) for 12m. p99 latency stable ~68ms, error rate 0.02%. GPU util at 78%.

lisa: running capacity probe via `curl -s https://canary-metrics.internal/health | jq .` — all probes ok. backlog queue < 6 for all pods.

mia: reminder: EU gating at t+30m unless US shows regressions. APAC will be t+1h after EU. Keep an eye on sustained p95 increases.

ops-oncall: noted. I'll watch autoscale and pod restarts. alert policy: trigger if errors >0.5% for 5m or p99 > 120ms.

ben: quick note — Dedicated pool quotas checked: us-west spare capacity = 12 GPUs, eu-central spare = 6, apac-sg spare = 8. Burst policy set to 2x for US only.

arjun: plan: US -> 25% traffic after 20m -> 50% after 40m -> full at 60m provided no alerts. EU pinned at current stable (v3.7.0) until manual green. APAC pin to v3.6.x until EU full release.

mia: @lisa @ops-oncall add rollback triggers to the thread so everyone knows the threshold.

lisa: rollback triggers: 1) errors >0.5% sustained 5m, 2) p99 increase >2x from baseline for 10m, 3) sustained queue growth > 50% for 15m. If any trigger hits, execute `deploy-bot: rollback region <region> to v3.7.0` and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary pods (id: canary-7f4) rolled to v3.7.1 at 1854009999. Health check passed: 200/200.

ryan: quick QA checklist: 1) release notes posted, 2) DB migration is no-op, 3) feature flags enabled for slice only. Confirmed?

arjun: release notes posted: https://docs.internal/releases/v3.7.1. migration: no-op. flags: experimental-cache-merge=on for region-slice-1 only.

ben: also deployed quantization profile QP-12 for this slice to save ~12% token cost. monitor quality metrics.

mia: if we see eval regressions > 3% on the smoke prompts, pause rollout and revert quantization first.

ops-oncall: setting ephemeral dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/slices/1854009999, added heatmap for latency, error spikes, and queue.

lisa: ran capacity sweep script: `./scripts/capacity-check --region us --min-gpus 6 --safety 0.2` -> OK. Will re-run before EU.

deploy-bot: Traffic slice update: us region moved to 25% at 1854010800.

arjun: early signal: p99 moved from 68ms -> 72ms, error rate steady. no action yet.

mia: hold the EU gate at t+30 unless ops says green. @ops-oncall status?

ops-oncall: EU canary readiness: smoke tests queued. expected finish in ~5m. network latency to eu proxies normal.

deploy-bot: EU canary scheduled at 1854011600 in dry-run mode (no traffic).

ben: note — EU has a different kernel selector, double-check CPU-side tail latencies after enabling. setting a 10m watch.

lisa: heads-up: we're seeing a 3% increase in token generation retries in US slice (from 0.8% -> 3.8%) over the last 4m. correlating with cache-miss rate spike.

arjun: interesting — was quantization causing this? Ben?

ben: quantization changes only affect compute; retries look like transient network to cache-tier. I'm spinning a cache debug trace.

mia: if retries persist above 2% for 10m we pause the next traffic bump. current bump hold.

deploy-bot: US rollback command ready. To rollback: `deploy-bot: rollback region us to v3.7.0` (requires 2 approvals).

ryan: I'm +1 for holding. @arjun @lisa, can we get two approvals if we decide to pause?

arjun: +1 to hold. investigating.

lisa: +1. pausing EU gating until we stabilise.

ops-oncall: scaling up cache read replicas by +2 in US to mitigate misses (manual action). monitoring impact.

deploy-bot: action: cache replica scale request started at 1854012000.

ben: trace shows a backend-side connection timeout at 1854011965 hitting a single node. I killed that pod and it's been replaced. retries dropping.

lisa: retries down to 1.1% after replacement. queue also trending back to normal.

mia: good recovery. propose we resume EU dry-run in 10m and US bump to 40% delayed 10m. any objections?

arjun: fine with me.

ryan: no objections. I'll update the release notes with the short incident log.

deploy-bot: status update scheduled at 1854012600.

ops-oncall: creating incident note and linking to postmortem template just in case: /incident create "cache-retry-spike-us"

mia: thanks everyone. short stand-up in 8m to confirm EU readiness. :white_check_mark:
